name: Proper Retort
body:
School evocation Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 feet
Target attacking creature
Saving Throw Reflex (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You shout a magically enhanced, vicious insult at an attacking creature. When you are damaged by a weapon or natural attack from a creature you can see, you may cast this spell as an immediate action. You reduce the damage taken by your caster level to a minimum of no damage. If the damage from the attack is entirely prevented the attacker takes 1d4 force damage for every 2 caster levels you possess, a successful Reflex save negates this damage.
